result:
Fixed in `anthrouter/pace.py`. `period_workday_dates` counted the exclusive period end (Oct 1, a Thursday) as a workday for UTC, so September 2026 got 23 workdays instead of 22.

The end date is now taken from the last instant before `period_end`, and I updated the docstring to match. The 53 pace tests pass. The full suite was still running when I stopped, so I haven't seen its result.
